highlights.name: Bohemian Lifestyle
highlights.text: Embrace the bohemian lifestyle in picturesque landscapes, where all Sims can learn to live comfortably off the land.

highlights.name: Healing Haven
highlights.text: Tap into natural healing and self-care through a strong local connection with Apothecary arts.

highlights.name: An Enchanting World
highlights.text: From the forested Everdew to the Coast of Adhmor, delight and discovery await in the special landmarks, plants, and stories of this world.
